candidates.hook: Father Thomas asks, “You want eyes inside the council chamber itself?”
candidates.cliffhanger: Father warns what will happen to him if the Duke discovers their conspiracy, leaving his fate uncertain.
candidates.why: High‑stakes question and threat hook viewers instantly, then ends on a tense warning before any answer.

candidates.hook: Father Thomas declares, “A priest and a disgraced bride meeting before dawn in her bedchamber….”
candidates.cliffhanger: Catherine demands the council stay open for ten days, leaving Father’s reaction unknown.
candidates.why: A shocking line sets a scandalous tone, then cuts on a bold demand that begs a response.

candidates.hook: Father Thomas questions, “If I keep the hearing open… what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?”
candidates.cliffhanger: Catherine promises to keep him safe, but the pact’s consequences remain unseen.
candidates.why: A direct threat to a powerful Duke creates immediate tension; ends on a seductive promise that leaves the outcome hanging.

moments.desc: Father Thomas reveals the scandalous meeting of a priest and disgraced bride.
Father Thomas asks Catherine to state her request plainly.
Father warns of the Duke’s possible discovery of their treason.
Father Thomas extends his hand, sealing a secret pact with Catherine.
